segments.tha-ap47:1.3: Okkhittacakkhu [khittacakkhu (ka. sī. ka.)] mitabhāṇī, satimā saṃvutindriyo.
segments.tha-ap47:2.3: Tena buddhaṃ apūjesiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.
segments.tha-ap47:3.1: “Āropitā ca te pupphā, chadanaṃ assu satthuno;
segments.tha-ap47:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā pañcahatthiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.

lines: So attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā paccakkhato paññāya diṭṭhapubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento sumedho nāma sambuddhotiādimāha.
Tattha sumedhoti sundarā medhā catusaccapaṭivedhapaṭisambhidādayo paññā yassa so bhagavā sumedho sambuddho antarāpaṇe antaravīthiyaṃ gacchatīti sambandho.
Mitabhāṇīti pamāṇaṃ ñatvā bhaṇanasīlo, pamāṇaṃ jānitvā dhammaṃ desesīti attho.
